node.title: Rank-eleven rank-two-triple shortening and transversality
node.closure: the genuine rank-two horn becomes a shortened correction-rank-five/six 2 x 3 bucket with a low direction-exception record
node.statement: In the genuine rank-two-triple output of the base-free KoalaBear rank-eleven 2 x 5 factor branch, the common residual kernel has dimension three and is divisible by the triple locator. The bucket's mass 388650911452 exceeds the four-space cap 63397365764, so its correction rank is five or six. Common-core cancellation transports it to parameters (2097149,1048573,1116045), preserving first-owned mass and at least 37733 residual roots per class. Exact support-local transversality then forces a selected direction approximation with at most 9 exceptions in rank five or 294 in rank six. Neither output is paid here.
